maria_cs: Quick weekly pulse for BrightNorth — saw a short error spike yesterday morning. putting a quick breakdown here so eng can triage. 5xx spike, timeouts, and a couple of rate-limit bursts.

anita_success: Thanks Maria — can you paste the top failing endpoints and time ranges?

maria_cs: Sure. Summary numbers (24h window): total requests 182k, overall error rate 1.3% (baseline 0.4%). Breakdown: 5xx 0.7% (~1,274 errors), timeouts 0.4% (~728), rate limits 0.2% (~364). Most activity between 2025-12-03 10:20–11:15 PST.

li_eng: Copy. Any correlation with recent canary or config pushes?

maria_cs: No deploys logged in that window per deploy-bot, but we did flip a batch-size tweak for the embeddings cache around 09:50 PST earlier in the day.

deploy-bot: deploy: embeddings-cache-batchsize -> 256 by infra-team completed at 2025-12-03T09:50:12Z.

li_eng: That could explain an increased KV pressure and timeouts on /v1/embeddings. Can you share top endpoints by error count?

maria_cs: Top failing endpoints (ordered):
- /v1/embeddings (client=BrightNorth-main): 620 total failures — 60% 5xx, 30% timeouts, 10% rate-limit.
- /v1/generate (client=BrightNorth-chat): 420 failures — mainly 5xx (85%), some truncated streams.
- /v1/stream (client=BrightNorth-realtime): 140 failures — mostly timeouts during open connections.
- /v1/rerank (client=BrightNorth-batch): 86 failures — small burst of 429s after 10:40 PST.

tom_infra: Thanks. Do we have per-region breakdown? BrightNorth routed mostly to us-west-2 and eu-west-1.

maria_cs: yes — 78% of failing requests hit us-west-2, 20% eu-west-1, 2% other regions.

li_eng: I'll start a quick repro against us-west-2 on staging with the new batchsize and capture p99/p95. Can someone drop a representative curl for a failing embeddings call?

maria_cs: Pasting a sanitized example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":["doc text..."],"batch_size":256}' --max-time 8``` We saw a bunch of socket timeouts with --max-time 8.

li_eng: Perfect. I'll run that and also check KV cache OOM/evict logs. @tom_infra could you keep an eye on node-level swap and GPU memory metrics for us-west-2?

tom_infra: Will do — spinning up dashboards and alerting on memory+fd usage for the affected pool.

manual_action: Suggested immediate mitigations: roll back batchsize to 64 for BrightNorth routing or enable adaptive backpressure on embeddings path.

anita_success: From CS side I can coordinate a brief maintenance window with BrightNorth if they're OK with a short rollback. That will help reduce customer-facing errors.

li_eng: For triage owners: li_eng -> investigate cache pressure + K/V evictions; tom_infra -> infra metrics + temporary routing; anita_success -> customer comms + rollback approval.

maria_cs: Thanks team — will update this thread with any customer replies. Short-term ETA for rollback decision 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

li_eng: Noted, will post findings in 45m.

maria_cs: End of thread for now; will ping if BrightNorth responds. :white_check_mark:
